en: A vintage black-and-white postcard depicting a hilly and wooded landscape. In the foreground, there is a footbridge with wooden railings, and two people are standing on or near the bridge. In the background, up the hill, a large building or possibly a castle is visible above the treetops. The text is in German, printed in red, and there is a publisher's mark along the bottom.
